meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 这个技能会为 NanoClaw 接入一个 Dial 真实电话号码:登录配号后,可收发短信、接打 AI 语音电话;还会请你选择谁能短信,并配对你的手机。
howto.when: 当你说要给 NanoClaw 加一个 Dial 电话号码,用于短信或 AI 语音通话时,技能会开始配置。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加一个 Dial 电话号码
say.note: 会引导你完成接入、登录、配号和手机配对。

say.text: 把 Dial 号码的短信权限设成仅限我
say.note: 选“仅限我”,拒绝陌生人来信。

say.text: 把 Dial 号码的来电提示语改成:先问名字再记留言
say.note: AI 接电话时会按这句提示应答。

howto.what_en: Adds a real Dial phone number to NanoClaw for SMS and AI voice calls. Setup signs you in, asks who may text the line, restarts the service, registers the number, and pairs your phone.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to add a Dial number to NanoClaw for SMS or AI voice calling, and the setup starts.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs setup: login, line registration, phone pairing.

say_en.text: Set the Dial line so only I can text it.
say_en.note: Owner-only policy; messages from strangers are refused.

say_en.text: Change the Dial number's inbound greeting so the AI asks for name and message.
say_en.note: The AI answers incoming calls using that prompt.
